react_native_issues.issue: RtcSurfaceView canvas for the remote host uses sourceType=VideoSourceCamera. Per SDK source (node_modules/react-native-agora/src/internal/IAgoraRtcRenderView.tsx:24-28) any defined sourceType other than VideoSourceRemote routes to RtcEngine_setupLocalVideo, so native AUDIENCE would render black. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/live-video.native.tsx:170-182. Fix: sourceType: role==='host' ? VideoSourceType.VideoSourceCamera : VideoSourceType.VideoSourceRemote (or omit sourceType for audience since uid!=0 already routes to setupRemoteVideo).

engine.startPreview() return code not checked (line 126); previewReady is set unconditionally. If camera is busy/fails, previewReady=true yields a black RtcSurfaceView with no error. Minor. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/live-video.native.tsx:125-128.

BLUETOOTH permission covers <=Android 11 only; Android 12+ (API 31+) needs BLUETOOTH_CONNECT for bluetooth-headset audio routing per Agora playbook. Cosmetic for camera preview. Reference: /app/frontend/app.json:25.

rca_of_issue: User-reported host black preview: root cause was join/canvas UID mismatch (uid 1 vs 0) + preview gated on channel join — now fixed and verified in code. Remaining latent bug found this round: audience path reuses the same canvas object with sourceType=VideoSourceCamera for the REMOTE uid; SDK internal getFuncName (node_modules/react-native-agora/src/internal/IAgoraRtcRenderView.tsx:18-33) treats any defined non-Remote sourceType as setupLocalVideo, so native audience renders nothing (black). Mitigation: one-line sourceType conditional by role. Reproduction: install APK as guest, join a live -> black video area while web guests work.
